summary: Chill Touch with your spell attack, Advantage on Intimidation, and a dim glow.
text: While holding this staff you can cast Chill Touch with it using your spell attack bonus, you have Advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks, and it sheds Dim Light in a 5-foot radius.
